title: Claude now seems to forget that we allow  "Do you trust the files in this folder?"
body: Every time that i start a new claude session in a previously approved folder, it will always ask to trust the folder. Is it possible to either fix this, or allow some mechanism to disable, or whitelist some folders?
author: balheru

top_comments.author: wolffiex
top_comments.body: Do you also get the prompt to set your theme? If so, we are mistakenly failing to load your settings. If not, we'll need to debug some more.

top_comments.author: balheru
top_comments.body: I do not have the theme situation going on. any debug logs I can give to you? ( it would be cool to permanently set some configs for this )

top_comments.author: balheru
top_comments.body:
After a bit of messing around:
- in the home folder "/Users/balheru" if i reconnect to a session it does not ask me for permissions if i previously approved
- in the home folder if i start a new session, it will ask me for permissions, regardless if i approve before
- in any other folder if i approve once it never asks me again.
